title: Result of one tool run on one benchmark
description: Written by every tool runner (Python, MATLAB, Julia, dReach wrapper) so that results can be aggregated into one comparison table. Infinite values are encoded as the strings "inf" / "-inf".

verdict.description: unreachable_proven: sound proof that no trajectory reaches the target within the horizon. reachable_proven: sound proof that some trajectory does. reachable_witness: a numerically simulated trajectory reaches the target (numerical evidence, not a formal proof). reachable_possible: a sound over-approximation intersects the target (or delta-sat), so reachability cannot be excluded. reachable_estimated / unreachable_estimated: answer of an approximate method (sampling, grids) without a guarantee. unknown: the method completed but cannot decide. unsupported: the benchmark is outside the tool's problem class. set_explosion: the over-approximation diverged before covering the horizon. out_of_memory: the method needs more memory than the limit of the run. timeout / error: the run did not complete.

agrees_with_expected.description: true/false when the verdict asserts reachable or unreachable, null otherwise.

reach_time_bounds.description: Union of intervals that contain the times at which a trajectory can be in the target set.

runtime_s.description: Wall-clock seconds; 'total' is required, other phases (setup, compile, solve, check, ...) are optional.
